# Bhaskar Pathak

> Bhaskar Pathak is an independent web designer and creative developer based in India and working with clients worldwide.

Canonical website: https://bhaskarjyotipathak.in
Contact: hello@bhaskarjyotipathak.in
GitHub: https://github.com/Bhaskar-J-Pathak

## What Bhaskar does

- Custom web design for startups and growing businesses
- Creative frontend development with Next.js
- Product and interface design
- Art direction and visual identity
- Motion and interaction design
- Responsive website development

Bhaskar combines visual direction, purposeful interaction and resilient frontend code. His work focuses on distinctive websites that remain fast, clear and usable across devices.

## Selected work

- Rajdhany Realtors, 2025: brand direction and web development
- Xvault Studio, 2025: product design and creative development
- Spylt, 2025: brand direction and creative development
- Lucas Danielsson, 2025: creative development and 3D interaction
- Previous Portfolio, 2024: portfolio design and creative development

## Working style

- Clarity before decoration
- Motion with a reason
- Code that protects the original design idea
- Strategy before spectacle
- Strong typography and purposeful interaction
